stories.title: Maxey-led Sixers turn Philly boos into cheers in thrilling 29-point comeback
stories.summary: Booed after trailing by 24 at the half, the Sixers rode a game-high 32 points from Tyrese Maxey to erase a 29-point deficit and stun the Cavs 114-106 on Thursday.

stories.title: Faulk, Hall of Famer and Southern coach, reveals Parkinson's diagnosis
stories.summary: Marshall Faulk said that in discussing his illness in a podcast appearance Wednesday, "I want to help as many people as I can."

stories.title: LeBron responds to Trump's criticism, calls it 'slow news day in office'
stories.summary: LeBron James responded to President Trump's criticism by calling it a "slow news day at the office."

stories.title: SGA opts for 'respect' over record, subs out of blowout to end 20-point streak
stories.summary: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's historic streak of 20-point games ended Thursday night when he finished with 17 in a 96-84 win over the Nuggets.

stories.title: Appalachian St. ends James Madison's undefeated start to season
stories.summary: James London kicked a 40-yard field goal in overtime to give Appalachian State the win Thursday night and leave just five unbeaten teams in the FBS.
